name: CodeSentinel
description: Multi agent code reviewer. An orchestrator delegates to bug, security and test coverage specialists and returns a prioritised review report with severity ratings. Read only: it never modifies code or posts on its own.

provider.organization: Bala Week 3 project, The Gen Academy

skills.name: Review source code
skills.description: Runs the bug, security and test agents in parallel on one or more files and returns a report with a verdict (approve, request changes, block), a quality score and ranked findings.
examples: Review this Flask handler for security issues
Which functions in payments.py need tests?

skills.name: Review a GitHub pull request
skills.description: Fetches the changed files of a public pull request and reviews them. Posting the result back is a separate, human approved action and is not exposed over A2A.

skills.name: Deterministic security scan
skills.description: Fast rule based scan with CWE ids, no LLM involved.

x-task-lifecycle: submitted -> working -> input-required (human approval) -> completed | rejected | failed
